fusions.name: Picked Out From Afar
fusions.desc: Throws the blade at the spot you picked out, dealing 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Level Gaze, Level Sweep
fusions.desc: A level sweep through a cone 3 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gaps Widen
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Places That Open
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour. Your dodge chance rises by 4%.
